title: EP 33 — MODULAR CLAUDE.MD
lines: Your CLAUDE.md is getting huge. A long file means weaker adherence. Clawd lets you split it.
Reference another file with at path. Clawd expands it and loads it into context at launch, alongside the CLAUDE.md that points to it.
Both relative and absolute paths work. Relative resolves next to the importing file. Imports nest up to four hops.
Backtick it to keep it literal
Import parsing skips code spans. Wrap it in backticks to mention a path without importing it.
Ask about a rule that only lives in the imported file, and Clawd answers from it. Proof the import loaded.
Modular memory beats one giant file. Follow for a daily Clawd tip.
